functions.name: get_available_spaces
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_available_spaces(p_vehicle_type_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_exclude_reservation_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
with compatible as (select * from public.parking_spots where active and inventory_state='available' and (p_vehicle_type_id is null or polyvalent or vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id)),
points as (select p_start t union select entry_at from public.reservations where entry_at>=p_start and entry_at<p_end union select starts_at from public.capacity_blocks where active and starts_at>=p_start and starts_at<p_end),
counts as (select t,
(select count(*) from compatible p where not exists(select 1 from public.capacity_blocks b where b.active and b.spot_id=p.id and b.starts_at<=t and b.ends_at>t)
and not exists(select 1 from public.parking_sessions s where s.spot_id=p.id and s.status='inside' and s.reservation_id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and true)
and not exists(select 1 from public.reservations r where r.assigned_spot_id=p.id and r.id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and r.entry_at<=t and (r.exit_at>t or (r.finished_at is null and not r.rotation_pending and exists(select 1 from public.parking_sessions held where held.reservation_id=r.id))) and (r.status in ('confirmed','checked_in') or (r.status='pending_payment' and r.expires_at>now()))))
- (select count(*) from public.reservations r where (p_vehicle_type_id is null or r.vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id) and (r.assigned_spot_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.parking_spots l where l.id=r.assigned_spot_id and l.inventory_state='legacy')) and r.id is distinct from p_exclude_reservation_id and r.entry_at<=t and (r.exit_at>t or (r.finished_at is null and not r.rotation_pending and exists(select 1 from public.parking_sessions held where held.reservation_id=r.id))) and (r.status in ('confirmed','checked_in') or (r.status='pending_payment' and r.expires_at>now())))
- coalesce((select sum(blocked_spaces) from public.capacity_blocks b where b.active and b.spot_id is null and (p_vehicle_type_id is null or b.vehicle_type_id=p_vehicle_type_id) and b.starts_at<=t and b.ends_at>t),0) available from points)
select greatest(0,coalesce(min(available),0))::integer from counts;$function$
